reference.code: const nums=(s:string):number[]|null=>{if(!s)return null;let o:number[]=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};export function consecutiveRunSummary(s:string):string|null{let a=nums(s);if(!a)return null;let o:any[]=[];for(const x of a){let q:any=o[o.length-1];if(q&&q[0]===x)q[1]++;else o.push([x,1])}return o.map(x=>x[0]+':'+x[1]).join(',')}
